feeds.title: Children and Divorce Blog
feeds.description: Kids are our future, and divorce can be tough on them, too. That's why Christina McGhee created this blog to help separated and divorced parents raise happy and secure kids. From this internationally recognized divorce coach, speaker and author of the highly acclaimed book 'Parenting Apart', learn how separated and divorced parents can raise happy and secure kids.

feeds.title: Lisa Thomson
feeds.description: Are you thinking about or are you going through a divorce? You've come to the right place. I share tips on divorce navigation and recovery. There's no shortage of experience. I share humorous and touching stories as well as the challenges I have faced in my own divorce. I also include lots of tips for dealing with common divorce issues.

feeds.title: My Inner Struggle
feeds.description: Laura Ferri is a 41-year-old divorced mom of three and a self-proclaimed foodie. She loves being outside, taking pictures, and gardening. She writes this blog with the intent of sharing her story with the world, in hopes it can help others as well. She's committed herself to practicing her own affirmations, to be inspired by inspiring others.

feeds.title: Single Mom Smiling Blog
feeds.description: Single Mom Smiling is a blog by Kerri Lynn Bishop, a Catholic mom of five who was left by her husband while she was pregnant. She writes honestly about the struggles of being a single mom like handling emotions, money, and raising kids while leaning on her faith. Her posts and podcast give encouragement, hope, and practical tips to help other single moms find peace, strength, and joy again.

feeds.title: Single Mom Nation
feeds.description: Covers advice for single mothers of all experiences, women seeking divorce, ending a relationship, deploying with the military or supporting a deployed parent, who feel alone in a marriage or partnership, who are considering parenting and relationship options or some other circumstance that lifts them up as the primary person raising a child.

feeds.title: DivorcedMoms.com
feeds.description: Online community for divorced women and single mothers, advice on Relationships, Health, Beauty, Sex, Parenting, Finances, Divorce Blogs, Resource Articles and more.

feeds.title: Seven Wild And Free
feeds.description: Vegan, Ultra Running, Single Momma to 6 Amazing Littles! Adventuring is what we do!
